services.label: SERVICES AND PRICING
services.intro: Choose how deeply to explore your idea. We will help find what your space needs.
services.fineprint: Prices per m² and final package contents are agreed individually. This is a preliminary outline.

therapy.description: Therapeutic design pays closer attention to your needs, habits and feelings. Light, materials and daily routines come together in a personal space of comfort.

process.label: THE PROCESS
process.intro: You know what is happening at every step, and what comes next.
process.fineprint: The scope of each step depends on the package. Visits, supervision and sourcing are agreed separately.

sketch.title: Initial design
sketch.work: We discuss your goals, gather information and prepare a design brief.
sketch.result: An initial design booklet, measured plan and furniture layout.

visual.title: Visual review
visual.work: We review materials, colours, lighting and the atmosphere of the space.
visual.result: Moodboards or 3D visuals, depending on the chosen package.

drawings.title: Drawings and documents
drawings.work: We turn approved decisions into materials for implementation.
drawings.result: Drawings and wall elevations within the agreed scope.

supervision.title: Design supervision
supervision.work: We agree on a suitable format for support during implementation.
supervision.result: Feedback on implementation within the agreed scope.

sourcing.title: Sourcing
sourcing.work: We select furniture, materials, textiles and other elements.
sourcing.result: A selection and specifications within the agreed scope.

about.label: IRINA AND HER APPROACH
about.eyebrow: A PLEASURE TO MEET YOU. I AM IRINA.
about.paragraph1: I love spaces where people can be themselves. Where materials invite touch, light changes with the day and every object finds its place.
about.paragraph2: I bring aesthetics together with attention to daily life: your rituals, favourite activities and what helps you feel at home.

clarity.description: Clear planning, comfortable light and easy movement.

personal.title: Made for you
personal.description: Decisions shaped by your needs and the way you live.
